jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Nasdaq Technology is looking for a passionate Lead Product Manager with focus on Counterparty Credit Risk to join the Mumbai technology center in India. If Innovation and effectiveness drive, you forward this is the place for you!
Nasdaq is continuously revolutionizing markets and undergoing transformations while we adopt new technologies to develop innovative solutions, constantly aiming to rewrite tomorrow. As a Lead Product Manager, the candidate is supposed to own and drive the XVA and Monte Carlo PFE (MCPFE) product areas within our Credit Risk platform. This role is critical to scaling the XVA/MCPFE solution to support increasing client adoption, regulatory expectations, and advanced use cases across global banks and financial institutions

With this position we offer

Join the team which sits at the intersection of quantitative finance, product strategy, engineering execution, and client engagement, and team works closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, CS, QA and Support. The team owns the analytical, experimental, investigative, and testing efforts in support of new product development engineering.

Role Responsibilities

As a Lead Product Manager , your focus will be coordinating all phases of new product development, including research and develop. Besides working closely with your colleagues in Mumbai, you will also work closely with Nasdaq teams in other countries.

They would own the end‑to‑end product lifecycle for XVA and MCPFE modules, including roadmap definition, prioritization, and delivery.
They would Leads project/program teams from build to delivery of fully developed products that are ready for customer use.
Would translate sophisticated quantitative and regulatory requirements into clear functional specifications.
Would work closely with Engineering to guide develop decisions, performance improvements, and architecture evolution.
Acts as the primary product contact for clients, support team, Presales and Client Services. Participate in client workshops, demos, critical issues, and roadmap discussions.
Makes recommendations for product solutions based upon feedback from customer base, aligning the recommendations to the customer’s business strategy

We expect you to have: (Minimum Qualifications)

Experience Level: 6+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically in Counterparty Credit Risk domain.
Solid understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk. Experience with quantitative finance models and risk analytics in capital markets or banking.
Ability to work closely with Quants and Engineers on model behavior, performance, and data flows.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical and non technical audiences.

Education Qualification:

MBA or master’s in quantitative finance or related rigor
CFA, FRM
Top Knowledge of Java/SQL

jobs.description:
Product Manager Specialist, Nasdaq Eqlipse Trading Ocean

Nasdaq is seeking a Product Manager to support the Ocean trading platform portfolio within Nasdaq Eqlipse. The role focuses on technology for U.S. equities trading, including alternative trading systems and single-dealer platforms. Working with senior product leaders, sales, engineering, operations, and compliance teams, the Product Manager will help manage product requirements, roadmaps, pre-sales activities, releases, and client implementations across matching, surveillance, regulatory reporting, infrastructure, and operational solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to develop product-management expertise in electronic trading while working with experienced capital-markets and technology professionals. The successful candidate will contribute to mission-critical platforms, engage with leading financial institutions, and gain exposure to the complete product lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

- Support product strategy, roadmap planning, market research, and prioritization for U.S. equities trading solutions.

- Assist with pre-sales discovery, demonstrations, proposals, client presentations, solution scoping, and responses to requests for information.

- Translate client needs into requirements for matching engines, surveillance, regulatory reporting, infrastructure, hardware, and software.

- Coordinate with product management, engineering and operations on product delivery, deployment, change management, incident follow-up, and release readiness.

- Monitor client feedback, market trends, competitors, and regulatory developments affecting ATS and single-dealer platforms.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

- At least 8 years of experience in capital markets, fintech, electronic trading, broker-dealer technology, or financial services.

- At least 5 years of experience in product management, product strategy, solution management, or a comparable role.

- Knowledge of U.S. equities trading, market structure, ATSs, or broker-dealer execution environments.

- Experience supporting product roadmaps, requirements, client engagements, demonstrations, or proposals.

- Strong communication , analytical, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with matching engines, FIX connectivity, market data, surveillance, regulatory reporting, or low-latency trading systems.

As an AI Platform Product Manager you'll play a critical role in driving the vision, roadmap, and execution of the Nasdaq AI Platform , an enterprise AI and agent platform that enables teams to build, deploy, and interact with AI capabilities, agents, and workflows.

In this role, you will own key product areas, translating customer and stakeholder needs into well-defined features that ship to production. You will guide assigned product areas through the full product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements capturing to launch and ongoing iteration, ensuring the platform delivers measurable value to its users.

You'll thrive in this position if you're collaborative, customer-focused, and passionate about leveraging AI technologies to tackle real business problems. You bring strong product management expertise, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to bridge technical complexity and business value in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. You are equally comfortable partnering with engineering and design teams as you are communicating product vision, roadmap progress, and outcomes to leadership and end users.

Key Responsibilities
- Guide and define the product roadmap for assigned areas of the Nasdaq AI Platform, balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical feasibility, and platform strategy while clearly communicating vision and roadmap direction to stakeholders and senior leadership.
- Gather, triage, and prioritize feature requests from stakeholders, translating business and user needs into actionable requirements, user stories, and product decisions that support successful delivery.
- Own specific platform features and capabilities end-to-end, ensuring they progress through the full lifecycle from discovery, requirements definition, design, development, testing, launch, feature rollout, production support, and ongoing iteration.
- Partner closely with engineering, design, leadership, and end users throughout development sprints to clarify scope, remove ambiguity, make timely product decisions, align on goals, communicate progress, manage expectations, and coordinate successful product launches.
- Define and monitor success metrics for products and features, leverage data and user feedback to evaluate performance and inform future enhancements, collaborate with users to validate solutions, and maintain a strong understanding of the generative AI landscape, including LLMs, AI agents, and related technologies, to ensure platform capabilities address real-world challenges.

- Degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- 3-5+ years of relevant experience with a demonstrated mid-level track record in product management, including experience owning features throughout the full product lifecycle and managing product roadmaps.
- Demonstrated experience working with generative AI products, including areas such as large language models (LLMs), AI agents, or data-driven AI applications.
- Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, design, leadership, and user communities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences and communicate complex product decisions clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Product Lead- Collateral
jobs.location: USA - New York City - New York
jobs.description:
Product Lead – Collateral

About the Role
Nasdaq is seeking a Product Lead – Collateral to drive the development and growth of products in collateral services that work across Nasdaq Digital Liquidity networks. This role sits at the center of Nasdaq's Digital Collateral Ecosystem, combining traditional and tokenized collateral to deliver next-generation collateral management capabilities to buy-side and sell-side clients. The Product Lead will define and execute the product strategy that connects Nasdaq's Calypso Collateral Network, Canton Network connectivity, and DeFi/digital gateways, enabling clients to manage collateral across TradFi and DeFi environments with CDM-based smart-contract workflows for CSA exposure calculation, margin calls, optimization, and DvP settlement.

Why This Role Is Important
Collateral is fundamental to capital efficiency, liquidity, and risk mitigation across capital markets. As markets move toward tokenized and digital collateral—including stablecoins, tokenized securities, and money market funds—Nasdaq is positioned to lead the transformation of how collateral is mobilized, optimized, and settled. The Product Lead will be responsible for turning this vision into commercially successful products, ensuring Nasdaq's collateral solutions meet evolving client needs, regulatory expectations, and the demands of an increasingly digital market infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities
- Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define, develop, and position collateral product solutions in line with Nasdaq's strategy. Translate client and market needs into product requirements and roadmaps spanning traditional and digital/tokenized collateral, collateral optimization, eligibility and allocation logic, and connectivity across the Calypso Collateral Network and Canton/EVM environments. Work closely with FinTech product strategy to develop digital assets network services.
- Execution & Delivery: Manage all aspects of product execution—from scoping (products, legal agreements, collateral assets, custodians, growth opportunities) through target operating model design, business requirements definition, solution validation, UAT, and pilot/pre-production to production launch—ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
- Stakeholder Management: Lead cross-functional initiatives and collaborate with Technology, Product Delivery, Data, Operations, Sales, Legal, Risk, and Compliance. Support Sales and Relationship Management in client discussions and onboarding, and represent Nasdaq in industry working groups and client forums related to collateral and digital-asset innovation.
- Risk, Regulatory & Commercial: Ensure a strong understanding of risk, regulatory, and control requirements applicable to collateral, digital assets, and algorithmic components. Contribute to pricing, business cases, and go-to-market activities, and communicate collateral risks and product performance to senior stakeholders.

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will bring 5–7 years of relevant experience across product management and collateral-related domains within financial services, with demonstrable depth in the following areas:

Collateral Management (Core Competency)
• Deep understanding of the end-to-end collateral management lifecycle, including margin call issuance and response, collateral movements, substitutions, disputes, and settlement.
• Strong command of margining, haircuts, eligibility rules, collateral concentration, and counterparty exposure management.
• Hands-on familiarity with collateral management systems and platforms (e.g., Calypso, Colline, Acadia/Margin Manager, TriOptima/TriResolve).
• Experience with collateral optimization and mobilization strategies to improve funding efficiency and capital usage across TradFi and digital collateral.

Triparty Services
• Solid understanding of triparty collateral management flows and the roles of triparty agents, custodians, and clearing banks.
• Knowledge of bilateral, triparty, and sponsored collateral structures and how collateral is allocated, held, and optimized across them.
• Awareness of the operational and technology requirements needed to support triparty connectivity and interoperability.

Securities Services
• Understanding of custody, asset servicing, settlement, and fund administration and how these functions interact with collateral operations.
• Experience and expertise with the securities lifecycle from trade through settlement and the associated market infrastructure.
• Appreciation of how securities services underpin collateral eligibility, mobilization, and client servicing.

Repo
• Working knowledge of repo markets, financing structures, and collateral types used in repurchase agreements (bilateral, triparty, and sponsored repo).
• Understanding of GMRA documentation from an operational and collateral management perspective.
• Awareness of relevant regulation impacting repo and financing, including SFTR and Basel III/IV, and their implications for collateral practices.

Securities Lending & Borrowing
• Understanding of securities lending and borrowing markets and how securities finance desks operate.
• Familiarity with the GMSLA framework and associated legal documentation from a collateral perspective.
• Knowledge of the collateral implications of securities financing transactions, including eligibility, margining, and reuse.

Additional Valued Skills
• Experience in digital assets, tokenization, or DLT-based solutions, and understanding of ongoing market trends in crypto and tokenized assets.
• Business design leveraging algorithms, data, and AI concepts (business-level, not developer).
• Strong analytical, structuring, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, capable of managing relationships with senior executives and clients.
• Fluent English; additional languages an advantage.

Education & Experience
• Bachelor's degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required; an advanced/graduate degree is preferred.
• 5–7 years of experience within the financial sector, spanning product management and one or more of the collateral domains outlined above.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) are advantageous.

This position will be located in New York City or Toronto and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.
